bullets: Developed and maintained REST APIs using FastAPI, Django, and Flask, delivering scalable, production-ready backend services.

Built and enhanced three major projects: — Hotel & Rent Recommendation Platform leveraging ML/AI-based scoring and recommendation logic. — AI Agents Platform using GenAI models (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and vector DBs like Pinecone. — User Authorization & Digital Information Storage Platform, implementing secure tokenized data storage using JWK, JWT flows, and encrypted user data.
Implemented background task processing and automation using Celery and Redis.
Worked on web scraping for data ingestion using BeautifulSoup4 and external APIs.
Designed, optimized, and maintained both relational and non-relational databases, ensuring clean schemas and high-performance queries.
Integrated third-party services, authentication flows, and secure API communication with best practices in authorization and data handling.
Managed deployments on AWS including ECR, ECS, App Runner, EC2, RDS, S3, and configured reverse proxies using Nginx.
Containerized and deployed applications using Docker, Git workflows, and server-side process managers like supervisor and systemd.
Built AI-powered features using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, vector search, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines.
Collaborated with team members, contributed to requirement discussions, and maintained clear communication with clients.
Followed Test Driven Development (TDD) practices to ensure reliability and maintainability across projects.
